artStyle: Flat 2D cartoon illustration, rounded shapes, big expressive eyes, thick clean outlines, no realistic shading or texture.
lighting: Flat even lighting, no realistic shadows, bright and cheerful.
compositionRules: Large simple foreground subjects, bold silhouettes readable at small scale, upper third kept clear for captions.
culturalMarkers: Playful, universally friendly settings — playgrounds, homes, nature — avoiding culturally specific detail unless the topic requires it.
antiArtifactGuidance: Consistent line weight, no melted/extra fingers, proportional rounded character design, no photorealistic textures leaking in.
